Summary: MAP v3: domain rings colored by classifier state, subject-evidence cores, counterparties, FIELD STATE legend, subject brief above the map
Description: 1) Original intent: Founder ruling 2026-10-08 on the Claude Web mockup 'Structure Map v3' (claude.ai artifact NqhusS2FeWuN6JgJgWzKSc, version 1791464590-eae5): the MAP carries more of the story (state, subject evidence, who is connected), color is on by default (the all-neutral view is retired), and it must not read as dull or blank. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) each domain ring takes its per-domain classifier state color (section 6) from the same classifier the cones use, with section 6 motion: BUILDING soft pulse and bloom, HIGH slow compression with restrained bloom, TURBULENT irregular jitter with no glow, LOW slow drift, INSUFFICIENT static; reduced motion stops all of it; LOW is a filled disc and INSUFFICIENT an outline so they differ without motion; (b) a filled core inside each ring, in the ring's color, sized by the observations bound to the subject, with an 'N bound' count; field-only domains have an empty ring; (c) polarity as a triangle glyph after the domain label (up = constructive, down = fracture); no new color; (d) named counterparties from the canonical relationships drawn off the subject with their filing dates; (e) co-present edges stay lime with no arrowheads; the subject node, subject edge and counterparties are neutral; (f) a legend labeled 'FIELD STATE' with the five states, and a key for ring, core, polarity, co-present pair and subject relationship; (g) the subject brief (name, attribution pill from the Query Contract, subject and relationships rows) sits above the map, with the field header, metrics and field readout directly over it; (h) ring sizes stay fixed (no magnitude size cue). 3) Current implementation state: not built. The existing Dev MAP draws lime/white edges with arrowheads, neutral rings, the five-state legend removed in KRYL-1371, and the brief under the map. 4) Dependencies: DEF-1373 (classifier inputs are placeholders: T is a constant, so TURBULENT cannot fire and HIGH fires only in the formation-adapter path at magnitude >= 75; states shown today will be mostly BUILDING, LOW and INSUFFICIENT); KRYL-1372 (Query Contract attribution); KRYL-1371 and KRYL-1368 (layout); files: public/structure-field.html, src/components/analysis/structurepanel.jsx. Open: lime now means both a co-present edge and a BUILDING ring (Founder to confirm). 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: partly supersedes KRYL-1368 (layout) and builds on KRYL-1371; none known otherwise. 6) Maps to current product model: yes (section 6 states, section 16 polarity first-class, section 17 field vs subject terminology, section 21 presentation only).
